name: Filadd
long_description:
We provide premium, personalized courses for college entrance exams (like Chile’s PAES and Brazil’s ENEM) combining engaging video lessons, live tutoring, AI-powered study plans, and downloadable resources.
Today we serve over 25,000 students annually across Chile, Brazil, Argentina, and Colombia, with a 90% YoY growth and industry-leading margins.
one_liner: We help students in Latin America graduate from College.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Industrial Engineer- CEO - I'm passionate about technology and people management. I don't really know why I founded Filadd, but helping young people through their process of becoming adults make me proud and is the fuel I need to make the company grow

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Passionate for discovery and delivery of digital products. I have a full stack software developer background, which allows me to design digital products that are quick to implement while having in mind both the user and the business requirements.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I graduated as an Industrial Engineer in 2018. I am passionate about Marketing and Statistics. I always try to find an explanation for everything, if I don't understand something, i can't go to sleep peacefully. I am currently in charge of leading the Growth of Filadd.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
I love Technologies. I always try to be up to date with the latest tech tends and good practices.
I have double titulation in Bachelor of Applied Sciences and Computer Engineering.
When I was in college, I wanted to use my learned skills to create a solution for students. From that moment, I started to build FIladd. Currently I am CTO of the company.
